raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely fixed on the 1955 remake directed by Leopoldo Torre Nilsson without disambiguating the film title across different years. The question (without a year) likely referred to the earlier film directed by Leopoldo Torres Ríos, whose child is Leopoldo Torre Nilsson (the expected answer). By accepting the 1955 director and proceeding to find his child, the Planner set the process on the wrong branch and led to pursuing Pablo Torre instead of identifying Leopoldo Torre Nilsson as the child of the (earlier) director.
